title: Titan Amulet Launchers
summary: The Titan Amulet Launchers are a line of spring loaded launcher toys released released by Giochi Preziosi in 2011, based on Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. They are centered on being wearable Amulet devices that physically launch small Titan figures.

sections.heading: Design
sections.wikitext:
Each Titan Amulet launcher is shaped like a Titan Amulet and opens on a hinge. Inside sits a compact Titan figurine, posed in a seated or braced position. When the activation switch or button is pressed, the amulet springs open and propels the Titan forward, simulating the summoning of a Titan from the Amulet seen in the TV series. A molded clip on the back allows the launcher to be attached to a belt or waistband for role-play, combining portable play with interactive action features.

full_text:
The Titan Amulet Launchers are a line of spring loaded launcher toys released released by Giochi Preziosi in 2011, based on Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. They are centered on being wearable Amulet devices that physically launch small Titan figures.

Design

Each Titan Amulet launcher is shaped like a Titan Amulet and opens on a hinge. Inside sits a compact Titan figurine, posed in a seated or braced position. When the activation switch or button is pressed, the amulet springs open and propels the Titan forward, simulating the summoning of a Titan from the Amulet seen in the TV series. A molded clip on the back allows the launcher to be attached to a belt or waistband for role-play, combining portable play with interactive action features.
